title: Saved service fields
summary: Tachyon restores a service field marked `@SessionState` from `sessionStorage`. This works only for the current tab. It restores a field marked `@LocalState` from `localStorage`, so the value is shared across tabs. The value in the declaration is the default. Tachyon writes the field on every assignment, as JSON of at most 64 KiB, under a key named after the page, the service and the field. A field has one of the two markers, never both, and never together with `Needs`. The old field prefixes `$name` and `$$name` are refused; `ty migrate fix --write` changes them to the markers, and a value saved under the old key moves to the new key once. A Python field writes the marker in its type, as `Annotated[str, session_state]` or `Annotated[str, local_state]` (ADR 0093). Lua has no tab here, because the build refuses `@SessionState` and `@LocalState` in Lua Tac code with `TY1308`. C++ has no tab here, because the build refuses SessionState in C++ Tac code with TY1308 (ADR 0099).
